The Sandy Springs
connection.

City Springs combines a performing arts setting, the City Green and places to dine in a walkable center. Sandy Springs,
connected to your flight.

TRAVEL WITH A PURPOSE

A journey for your plans.

01

A City Springs evening

Build dinner and a performance into one evening plan. Give the curtain time and discuss the pickup after the show so the drive is settled before you take your seat.

02

An office-to-airport departure

If you are leaving directly from a meeting, share the office entrance and a reachable contact number. Tell us whether bags will be at the office or need to be collected from a hotel.

A LOCAL DETAIL
Can a Sandy Springs pickup include a hotel luggage stop?

Include the hotel address and the time needed to retrieve luggage when discussing the itinerary. The additional stop and any additional time should be agreed before booking.

Share your exact addresses, time, passengers and luggage when booking. Final availability, vehicle suitability and pricing are confirmed for the journey.
